title: Hurt by Basie's decision and why he went small
summary: Edison says it really hurt and guesses Basie's swing style did not fit the modern trend.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: Sure, anything. But we never expect those things to happen. Then when he told me he had gone without me, that really hurt me.
Well, I was going to say, it seems a bit peculiar.
But it sounds to me as though, you know, the office or somebody said, well, we'll have a more modern band or something like that.

Well, I don't think that was the point. As you said before, about the bill of goods, I think that's because -- what he was doing would never die. Swing is here to stay, you know. And his playing didn't coincide with the modern way, anyway, you know. It didn't.
Well, he couldn't make that switch if he wanted to.
